FeeBreakdown.description:
Itemized Indian equity/F&O transaction cost breakdown for a single fill.

Each component is computed by `vyapaar-market-finance::india::costs`'s statutory calculators; this type is just the shared wire shape they fill in.

gst.description: Goods and Services Tax (on brokerage + exchange charges).

account_id.description: Optional account ID (defaults to "default" if not provided)

fee.description:
Total transaction cost charged on this fill (brokerage, statutory levies, and exchange charges combined), in the fill's currency.

Defaults to zero for callers that don't yet have cost data (e.g. a simulated/paper fill). The statutory calculation itself lives in `vyapaar-market` (`vyapaar-market-finance::india::costs`); this crate only owns the contract.

Zero-dependency W3C trace context carrier.

Implements the W3C Trace Context Level 1 specification (`traceparent` header). Enables end-to-end distributed tracing across microservices, asynchronous actor hops, audit logs, and external bridges with zero external crate dependencies.

DomainEvent.description:
Tactical DDD aggregate domain events representing authoritative platform state transitions.

Immutable event stream payloads designed for distributed audit logging, event-sourced ledger reconstruction, and asynchronous cross-bounded-context bus delivery.

oneOf.description: Client order dispatched with registered `algo_id`, side, quantity, limit price, and timestamp.

price.description: Limit price, if limit or stop-limit.

oneOf.description: In-flight order price/quantity amendment with original and revised parameters.
Order withdrawal with optional cancellation source and reason.
Pre-trade risk gate denial event carrying rule identifier, attempted value, and threshold limit.

attempted_value.description: Numeric value that was attempted (e.g. order notional, quantity).

rule_id.description: Identifier of the risk rule that triggered rejection.

threshold_limit.description: Maximum or minimum threshold allowed by the risk rule.

oneOf.description: Emergency square-off or MIS auto-liquidation notification.

reason.description: Reason for auto-liquidation (e.g. RMS intraday auto-square-off).

oneOf.description: Intraday margin shortfall alert with required maintenance equity.

required_maintenance_equity.description: Total margin equity required to maintain open positions.

shortfall.description: Cash shortfall amount required to cure the call.

oneOf.description: Sizing determination event capturing sizing model inputs, computed quantities, and capping rules.

Tick.description:
Canonical typed Tick enum for broker feeds.

Indian broker feeds (Zerodha, Upstox, Fyers) deliver ticks in different shapes: - LTP only (lightweight mode) - Best Bid/Ask quote (with optional price band) - Full 5-level market depth

volume.description: Cumulative volume or last traded quantity

band.description: Scrip price band enriched by market data feed

asks.description: Ask depth levels (typically top 5 in Indian markets)

bids.description: Bid depth levels (typically top 5 in Indian markets)
